integration: Per-model and per-projection attributes; no global function replacement.
method: One shared G32 model with exact BF16 short scales, BF16 prefill, FP32 codec and context/head buckets. PDL waits at projection start; QKV/up trigger after wait, out/down trigger before stores. Third variant preloads only out/down static weight scales before waiting. Separate graph sets; eager Python dispatch restored with graph selection. Rotating/reversed order, one excluded warmup triplet. Cached cloned voice, all 32 codebooks, complete float32 PCM; no registration/network.
